description: Explicit, reviewable facts the KiCad schematic emitter may use to decide how a pin that the netlist does not connect is drawn, and which nets are fed from off-board. Every entry names the evidence it relies on. A pin the netlist connects is never given a no-connect, whatever this file says.

5V.reason: The recipe keeps the 5V_EN jumper fitted and holds the motor supply to 7-12 V, so the onboard regulator makes 5 V and this terminal is an output the build does not use. Without the jumper (motor supply above 12 V) the terminal needs an external 5 V logic supply and must not be left open.

COM.reason: Relay contact terminals switch an off-board load (recipe note on inductive loads).

NC.reason: Relay contact terminals switch an off-board load (recipe note on inductive loads).

load_termination.rule: Where an off-board load or cable attaches decides how the pin is drawn. breakout_terminal: the wires land on a terminal that belongs to the breakout module itself (screw terminal or solder pad on the module), so the carrier PCB has nothing to connect and a no-connect is correct (module_pins/build_pins entries with a termination field). carrier_connector: the pin reaches the carrier PCB through a pad with no terminal on the module, so the recipe wires it to a real connector part and the pin is never given a no-connect.

breakout_terminal_modules.mosfet-irlz44n: Low-side MOSFET driver breakout: VOUT+/VOUT- and the SIG control header are its own screw terminals/header. Standard hobby breakout; confirm against the exact board.
breakout_terminal_modules.l298n: L298N dual H-bridge breakout: OUT1-OUT4 are its own screw terminals.
breakout_terminal_modules.relay-1ch-5v: Relay breakout: COM/NO/NC are its own screw terminals.
breakout_terminal_modules.tp4056: TP4056 charger breakout: BAT+/BAT- are its own solder pads for the cell.

a4988-stepper.reason: A StepStick has no motor terminal; the coil pins reach the carrier through its header, so the motor lands on a 4-pin terminal.

max98357a-i2s-amp.reason: The footprint carries SPK+/SPK- as pads on the carrier and the data lists no onboard speaker terminal.

ldo-ams1117-3v3.reason: The AMS1117 breakout is three pads on the carrier with no terminal, so the 3.3V output leaves through a terminal.

ch340-usb-ttl.reason: Recipe note: the CH340 is powered from its own USB cable; the host is off-board.

mosfet-irlz44n.reason: Low-side MOSFET module: VOUT- is the switched return the module drives for the load, so it is only as supplied as the module ground (VIN-/GND) that feeds it.

mosfet-irf520.reason: Low-side MOSFET module: VOUT- is the switched return the module drives for the load, so it is only as supplied as the module ground (VIN-/GND) that feeds it.

SIG.reason: Servo control input; the catalog role 'pwm' describes the MCU side.

S.reason: Pin note: analog signal from the sensor.
